encryption_group_results.name: JavaScript and actual JSONB canonical digests agree despite object-key reordering

a head digest cannot diverge from its immutable generation receipt, including an attempted direct synthetic restore
receipt readback requires the original authenticated actor and exact request digest; changed input cannot reuse an operation ID
content-version UUIDs bind to an exact workspace/record/numeric-revision foreign key and cannot alias another record
authoritative classification, active state, exact current revision and reviewed consent are required even for a valid member with a record grant
all 8 tables force RLS; 12 disjoint capabilities deny raw tables, legacy entry points and internal completion helpers, and mixed issuer/content capabilities are rejected
immutable metadata excludes wrapped DEKs/ciphertext; direct truncate reaches exact FKs, rewrite/delete/cascading truncate reach append-only triggers, and populated retained state is unchanged
concurrent identical retries converge, while competing digest-and-generation CAS rotations yield one winner and preserve encrypted content
an older valid head restored beside newer immutable receipts cannot authorize reads, preparation or another rotation
current key-policy generation and the actual deployment environment must match before a prepared envelope can commit
membership, object grant/state and key revocations committed while admission waits prevent all persistence and succeeded events
a consent withdrawal that wins the shared workspace lock prevents a previously prepared encrypted commit
grant, role and key expiry after already-dispatched authority, key-row or audit-head waits rolls back material, head, receipt and commit audit
the repository-owned transaction rechecks the captured authority deadline at actual COMMIT after its SQL function has returned
failure after the mutation function but before COMMIT rolls back its material, metadata, head and succeeded audit event atomically
actual audit insertion failure after content identity insertion rolls back the identity, material, head, receipt and succeeded event
lost COMMIT acknowledgment exposes only a safe unconfirmed recovery binding; fresh readback proves the one committed operation without re-encryption
real stored ciphertext rejects a missing or wrong recovered wrapping key and becomes readable only after the exact synthetic key is recovered
synthetic material removal leaves immutable receipts and shared class keys intact; isolated material restoration must still pass current authorization
restoring older encrypted material into current consent state cannot revive a withdrawn source or its old operation receipt
prepare, load, receipt and exact replay all deny when current authority expires after the function but before actual main COMMIT, without changing retained content or audit
identity or feature closure after final issuer COMMIT suppresses reads and leaves completed writes explicitly unconfirmed with exact recovery
fresh issuer admission observes grant, consent and key revocation after main locks are released; a committed write remains recoverable only under the current required authority
an observed final issuer workspace wait and the issuer COMMIT itself recheck real authority expiry after main commit, then retire both contexts without delivering a stale result

grant, consent and representative deadlines survive the final composed host identity await: decrypt and recovery deny, owned plaintext is cleared, and committed stores retain only an unconfirmed operation handle
the initial authenticated principal remains pinned across real crypto and subsequent SQL calls even when the replacement actor independently has valid record authority
historical-generation receipt recovery remains separate from readable keys, latest wrapper generation and erasable material, while content delivery denies

main completion is bound to its actual PID and xid; uncommitted, cross-context, reused-ticket, wrong-digest and consumed-completion calls deny, while one separate issuer finish retires the exact result
